verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents region or data-residency selection for Mastra or Mastra Cloud. Mastra does let you run the server locally or deploy it to Mastra Cloud, Vercel, Netlify or Cloudflare. That is deployment flexibility, an adjacent capability that leaves residency to the user's host choice, so it earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
